input.subject: Washing machine – Flat 9, 59 Alder Lane, Eastmere ZZ4 4ZZ (Ref R/PM038-1)
input.body:
Dear Mr Ingram,

Thank you for confirming you are happy for the tenant to replace the washing machine at Flat 9, 59 Alder Lane, Eastmere ZZ4 4ZZ (ref R/PM038-1).

We have passed this on to the tenant. The tenant has told us their brother will take the old machine to the tip himself, so we are not expecting a removal charge. The new machine will belong to the tenant and leave with them when they vacate; we have noted this on the property record.

No further action is needed from you, and we will close this job on our side.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

data.reasoning: I should let the landlord know the tenant's brother is handling removal of the old machine, so no removal charge applies. Since this is tenant-led with no contractor involved, I'm weighing whether to move straight to closeout or hold until the tenant confirms the replacement is installed—given the tenant already expressed thanks and nothing agency-owned remains, closeout seems reasonable.
